spans.text: 安全：shell=False、workspace 边界、diff 确认、高风险子命令检测
spans.note: The prompt explicitly references existing safety mechanisms including workspace boundary enforcement, diff confirmation before writes, high-risk subcommand detection, and a confirmation gate (ConfirmGate) that requires user approval before dangerous tool operations. The shell=False policy prevents shell injection.

The prompt designs a ConfirmGate system that ensures users must explicitly approve consequential actions like file writes and tool executions. The confirm_required event flow keeps the user in control of all dangerous operations, preserving user agency.
